# services/deals.py
def create_deal(owner_id, title, amount):
    if amount <= 0:
        raise ValueError('amount must be positive')
    owner = User.query.get(owner_id)
    if owner is None:
        raise LookupError('unknown owner')
    deal = Deal(title=title.strip(), amount=amount, owner=owner)
    db.session.add(deal)
    db.session.commit()
    notify_slack(f'New deal {deal.title}')
    return deal
